difficulty_reason: The author constructs dihomologic coefficient complexes and an orientation-sensitive identification of their local columns with cellular chains, retaining the complete geometric pseudo-cell and relative-orientation foundations. The duality requires two explicit signed differential comparisons and naturality of localisation maps to turn the degenerate local-homology spectral sequence into compactly supported cellular cohomology, beyond applying a named duality theorem. In top dimension, the author additionally realizes the isomorphism by a canonical injection of local cycle complexes and proves the cokernel total complex exact. These full source-local geometric and signed chain-construction obligations exceed ordinary qualification algebraic topology; the known manifold corollaries and separate tropical application are uncounted.
